doc: The 'signals' group of host calls (cleat#3827). Each call is listed here as unbound ('pending: ...') until its binding lands; the PR that binds a call moves its entry from 'unbound' to 'bound' in THIS file and touches no other inventory file. See packages/cleat-ts/groups/README.md.

unbound.cleat_poll_signal: pending: a non-blocking read of a pending signal.
unbound.cleat_signal_workflow: pending: send a signal to another run.
